text:
maria.marketing: quick sync 1 launching a focused pricing page experiment next sprint: tier-label A/B (Flex vs Starter) + calculator UX (single-estimate vs committed-slab). want alignment on copy, tracking and lead routing.

sam.product: copy options: Flex / Committed / Enterprise or Starter / Growth / Enterprise. i'm leaning Flex for modern signal. also proposing we rename 'commit' to 'monthly commit estimate' to avoid legal tone.

kai.analytics: data note: 'Starter' historically pulls down perceived capability by ~0.5pp. recommend we A/B headline label + run the calc experiment in parallel. baseline simple calc conv = 4.0% -> target slab >= 4.6%.

maria.marketing: good. i'll draft two microcopy sets and a short bench narrative for the launch post: "Why pricing framing changes buyer intent" and link to the calc.

nora.cs: CS asks: add an FAQ anchor "Committed capacity & latency SLA" and make sure sales leads include tier_selected and variant so CS can triage incoming tickets. also include a short playbook blurb.

sam.product: frontend spec for calc: Variant A = Simple estimator (messages + avg tokens), Variant B = Slab calculator (monthly commit estimate slider, tier preview). sales form POST should include hidden fields: lead_origin=pricing_page, experiment=nov_pricing_test, variant=(simple|slab), tier_selected=(flex|committed|enterprise). example payload:
```json
{"lead_origin":"pricing_page","experiment":"nov_pricing_test","variant":"slab","tier_selected":"committed"}
```

devon.growth: webinar CTA under the calc: show email capture interstitial (email + use-case select) BEFORE registration so we can retarget. add utm_experiment=nov_pricing_test and utm_campaign=pricing_launch_blog.

kai.analytics: events to emit: pricing_page_view, tier_label_click, calc_variant_exposed, calc_submit, contact_sales_click, webinar_interstitial_submit. i'll track calc_clicks, contact_sales_clicks, sales_form_submits, 7d_MQL_rate and ARR_cohort_90d. set alert if slab lifts conversion >= 0.4ppt.

maria.marketing: small UX asks: 1) add footnote: "estimates exclude taxes and infra credits", 2) show a micro-FAQ link under the calc: "Which calculator should I use?" -> simple for quick checks, slab to model committed discounts.

nora.cs: sales routing rule: if tier_selected=committed AND monthly_estimate_tokens >= 100000 -> enterprise AE queue, else SDR queue. please add CRM tags: source=pricing_page, experiment=nov_pricing_test, variant=slab/simple.

sam.product: filed ENG ticket ENG-2055 for rounding/formatting edge cases in slab calc (guard against divide-by-zero and format to 4 decimal places) and for mapping hidden fields to the sales form. P1 for accuracy.

devon.growth: metrics + funnel: baseline simple->MQL 3.9% in last 30d. target slab >= 4.5% to promote. also want to capture demo scheduling rate at 30 days for ARR cohorting.

kai.analytics: i'll build a dashboard tile and baseline by Sun EOD. need final event schema by Thu noon. please confirm field names.

maria.marketing: timeline proposal: copy + FAQ updates Thu, ENG fixes Fri, QA Sat, flip A/B Mon 09:00 PT, run 14 days. marketing ops will own the flip and blog post.

sam.product: i'll confirm event names and ensure form fields map to CRM. will also add a tiny microcopy change: replace "commit" label in UI with "monthly commit estimate".

deploy-bot: /deploy staging-pricing-experiment v3.2 1 started by maria.marketing (CI #5277) :rocket:

nora.cs: CS will prep playbook snippets and link to /pricing#latency-sla. add canned responses for common commit vs pay-as-you-go questions.

maria.marketing: action recap: 1) draft copy + blog blurb (maria) 2) ENG fix ENG-2055 + hidden fields (sam) 3) dashboard + baseline (kai) 4) CS playbook + FAQ anchor (nora) 5) webinar interstitial + utm params (devon). i'll post experiment brief in #growth and tag owners when we flip. thanks!
